channel.description: Five questions on the Python basics from P1 Week 2 · Team, Requirements, Kanban: input/type conversion, branching, comparison/boolean operators and loops. The first three questions are identical to the quiz on the student page; the last two are additional questions for classroom use, e.g. as a starter for week 3 or a short test. Quiz · P1 Week 2 · Programming Skills 1. What happens with this code if you enter 15?
